Chatan shennira bo nega notnin lo kol shivat yeme hammishte. vechen im nira bivgadav o beveto en roin otan ad leachar hammishte. vechen baregel notnin lo kol yemot haregel shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 14 36)</small> "vetzivva hakkohen ufinnu et habbayit" vegomer im himtina tora lidvar harshut shello yittammeu kelav kal vachomer lidvar mitzva: 
En masgirin velo machlitin velo potrin ella bayyom sheyyire bo battechilla o bashshevii o beyom shelosha asar bingaim shemmasgirin bahen shene shavuot. mippene sheyyom shevii ole leminyan shavua rishon uleminyan shavua sheni bechol hannegaim ben benige adam ben benige battim uvegadim: 
En masgirin betoch yeme hesger velo machlitin betoch yeme hesger im nolad lo siman hechlet. velo machlitin hammuchlat im nolad lo nega acher. velo masgirin oto betoch yeme chilluto im nolad lo nega acher sherauy lehesger. aval im hayu bo shene negaim veraa ze vechazar veraa ze hare ze muttar lomar lo hare atta musgar baze umuchlat baze o muchlat baze umusgar baze ben battechilla ben bassof ben besof shavua rishon ben besof shavua sheni. veen roin shene negaim keachat ben bishne anashim ben beish echad shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 13 3)</small> "veraa hakkohen et hannega": 
Nagua shebba lakkohen laroto lo yomar lo lech veshuv ella nizkak lo miyyad. bau lefanav shenayim roe et harishon masgiro o potro o machlito vechozer veroe et hashsheni: 
En hakkohen zakuk levakkesh tachat atztzile yadav shel nagua o ben pechadav o betoch hakkematim shemma sham nega shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 13 12)</small> "lechol mare ene hakkohen". vechen behofech kullo lavan. vechetzad yaamod lifne hakkohen. im ish hu nire arom veomed keoder uchemosek zetim. veim ishsha hi niret arumma veyoshevet keorechet uchemenika et benah ucheoreget beomdim shemmagbahat yadah hayemanit ad sheyyiggale bet hashshechi. im haya hannega nire bahen bizman shehen omdin hare ze tame veim eno nira bahen keshehen omdin kach en nizkakin lo. ucheshem shehaadam nire lenigo kach hu nire letiglachto sheim lo yerae sear bechol besaro kesheyyaamod arom keoder uchemosek o keshetteshev haishsha kemo shebbearnu hare zo tiglachat keshera veen kohen zakuk lechappes bishar mekomot shemma nishar bahen sear af al pi shehu tzarich legalleach hakkol kemo sheyyitbaer:
Mishneh Torah, Defilement by Leprosy 10:

Tzaraat battim kishne gerisin ze betzad ze. nimtza rochov hannega kemo mekom tzemichat shesh searot bagguf vearko kishtem esre searot beribbua. vehappachot mishshiur ze bevattim tahor. vechol hashshiurin halacha lemoshe missinay: 
Shelosha simane tuma yesh bevattim. mare yerakrak vaadamdam vehappisyon. vechullan meforashin battora. ushene hammarot mitztarfin ze im ze. ufisyon hassamuch kol shehu veharachok kigris. aval hachozer achar hittoach kishne gerisin: 
En nige battim metammein ad sheyyihye mare hannega shafal min hakkir shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 14 37)</small> "shekaarurot" sheyyihyu shokin bakkirot. uvishne hammarot masgirin o machlitin uvefisyon nottzin. veim pasa achare hittoach notetz et kol habbayit kemo sheyyitbaer: 
Kesheyyerae nega babbayit afillu chacham sheyyodea vadday shezze nega lo yigzor veyomar nega nire li babbayit ella omer lakkohen <small>(Vayikra 14 la)</small> "kenega nire li babbayit". <small>(Vayikra 14 36)</small> "vetzivva hakkohen ufinnu et habbayit" afillu chavile etzim vachavile kanim veachar kach yavo hakkohen veyikkanes veyire hannega: 
Bayit afel en potchin bo challonot lirot et nigo ella im en hannega nire bo tahor. veachar sheyyire hakkohen et hannega yetze veyaamod al petach habbayit betzad hammashkof veyasgir o yachlit o yiftor shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 14 38)</small> "veyatza hakkohen min habbayit" <small>(Vayikra 14 38)</small> "vehisgir et habbayit". lo sheyyasgir vehu betoch beto o betoch bayit hamenugga o tachat hammashkof ella betzad pitcho. veim amad tachat hammashkof o shehalach leveto vehisgir hare ze musgar: 
En habbayit mittamme bingaim ad sheyyihye bo arba ammot al arba ammot o yeter vihe lo arbaa ketalim vehu banuy baaretz baavanim veafar veetzim shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 14 45)</small> "et avanav veet etzav veet afaro". aval im haya bo pachot mearba ammot al arba ammot o shehaya agol o shehaya baal shelosha ketalim o baal chamishsha o shehaya banuy bisfina o taluy al arba korot eno mittamme bingaim. haya banuy al arbaa ammudim mittamme bingaim: 
Kamma avanim yihyu bo en pachot mishshemone shete avanim bechol kotel kede sheyyihye kol kotel rauy lenega sheen habbayit mittamme bingaim ad sheyyerae bo kishne gerisin al shete avanim shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 14 40)</small> "et haavanim asher bahen hannega". vechamma etzim yihyu bo kede litten tachat hammashkof. veafar kede latet ben patztzim lachavero. aval im haya bo pachot mishshiurim ellu eno mittamme bingaim: 
Hallevenim vehashshayish enan chashuvin kaavanim. bayit sheechad mitztziddav mechuppe beshayish veechad besela veechad bilvenim veechad beafar eno mittamme bingaim: 
Bayit shello hayu bo avanim veetzim kashshiur venira bo nega veachar kach hevi lo avanim veetzim veafar tahor: 
Bayit shessikkecho bizraim bittelan hoil umeshammeshin tashmish etz hare hen keetz. veim nitma habbayit nitmeu immo tuma chamura kemo sheyyitbaer: 
Yerushalayim vechutza laaretz en mittammein bingaim shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 14 34)</small> "bevet eretz achuzzatchem" virushalayim lo nitchalleka lishvatim. uvatte haakkum shebbeeretz yisrael en mittammein bingaim: 
Hallokeach battim min haakkum yerae battechilla: 
Bayit shetztziddo echad akkum vetziddo echad yisrael tziddo echad baaretz vetziddo echad bechutza laaretz eno mittamme bingaim. ushear kol habbattim shebbeeretz yisrael mittammein bingaim ben tzevuim bide adam ben tzevuim bide shamayim: 
Bet haishsha bet hashshuttafin bet hakkeneset o bet hammidrash sheyyesh bahen dira lechazzanin o letalmidim mittammein bingaim: 
Kirot haevus vekirot hammechitztza shebbabbayit en mittammein bingaim:
Mishneh Torah, Defilement by Leprosy 15:
Nige battim yesh bahen hesger shelosha shavuot shehen tisha asar yom sheyyom shevii ole lechan ulechan veyom shelosha asar ole lechan ulechan nimtzeta atta lamed sheim tzarich lishlosha shavuot roehu bashshevii uveyom shelosha asar uveyom tisha asar. vehesger battim shelosha shavuot eno meforash battora vechen rov dine nige battim divre kabbala hen: 
Vechol haddinin hameforashin bahen battora uvedivre kabbala kach hem. kesheyyavo hakkohen veyire hannega shokea yerakrak o adamdam kemo shebbearnu yasgir shivat yamim vaafillu metzao kullo battechilla yerakrak o adamdam yasgir. uvashshevii roehu im keha hannega veen tzarich lomar im halach kolef mekom hannega bilvad vehabbayit tahor. metzao sheamad beenav velo pasa masgir shavua sheni veroehu beyom shelosha asar im keha hannega o halach lo kolef mekom hannega umetaher et habbayit betzipporim. veim matza hannega sheppasa besof shavua sheni o sheamad beeno choletz et haavanim shebbahen hannega umaktze heafar el michutz lair vetach et kol habbayit umasgiro shavua shelishi. uveyom tisha asar roehu im chazar bo nega kishne gerisin hare ze pisyon achare hittoach venotetz et kol habbayit veim lo chazar bo nega metaharo betzipporim. vechol zeman sheyyachzor bo hannega kodem sheyyetaharo betzipporim hare ze yinnatetz. veim nira bo nega achar shettiharo betzipporim yerae battechilla. vechen im pasa hannega besof shavua rishon choletz et haavanim shebbahen hannega vekotze heafar chutz lair vetach et kol habbayit umasgiro shavua sheni veroe im matza bo nega kishne gerisin hare ze pisyon achare hittoach venotetz et kol habbayit veim lo chazar bo nega metaharo betzipporim. vechol zeman sheyyire bo nega kodem tohora betzipporim yinnatetz. veim nira bo achar shettiharo betzipporim yerae battechilla: 
Keshehu choletz et haavanim shebbahen hannega eno choletz pachot mishshete avanim veeno notel avanim mitztzad ze umevian letzad ze shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 14 42)</small> "velakchu avanim acherot". velo afar mitztzad ze umevi letzad ze shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 14 42)</small> "veafar acher yikkach vetach et habbayit". veeno tach besid ella beafar shenneemar veafar acher yikkach vegomer. eno mevi even achat tachat shetayim shechalatz velo shete avanim tachat even achat chalutza ella mevi shetayim tachat shetayim. veyesh lo lehavi shetayim tachat shalosh: 
Haya hakkotel beno leven chavero shenehen choltzin ushenehen kotzim et heafar ushenehem meviin avanim acherot. aval baal habbayit mevi levaddo et heafar shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 14 42)</small> "veafar acher yikkach vetach" en chavero metappel immo beticha: 
Even shebbazzavit bizman shehu choletz choletz et kullah uvizman shehu notetz notetz et shello umanniach et shel chavero. veyesh baddavar safek im tihye zo shel chavero kemo yad laeven shello: 
Bayit shennira bo nega vehayta aliyya al gabbav noten et hakkorot laaliyya. nira baaliyya noten et hakkorot labbayit. lo hayta aliyya al gabbav avanav veetzav vaafaro kullan nittatzin immo. umatztzil et hammalbenin veet serige hachallonot: 
Hallokeach avanim mibbayit musgar uvenaan bevayit tahor chazar hannega lammusgar choletz et haavanim shebbattahor. nira nega al haavanim shebbana hammusgar yinnatetz vehabbayit hashsheni masgirin oto benega ze kedin kol bayit shennira bo nega battechilla: 
Ketzad metaharin et habbayit hamenugga. achar hachalitza vehatticha mevi mayim chayyim bichli cheres ushete tzipporim veetz erez veezov usheni tolaat ketohorat adam shebbearnu lechol davar. ella shebbeadam mazze sheva peamim leachar yado shel metzora uvevayit mazze sheva peamim al hammashkof shel bayit mibbachutz. ushear kol maasehen shavin:
Mishneh Torah, Defilement by Leprosy 16:
Bayit hamenugga av meavot hattumot kol hannogea bo nitma. vechen avanim shecholtzin mimmennu achar hesger o avanim veetzim veafar shel bayit keshennottzin oto kullan avot tumot. vechol kezayit mehem metamme adam vechelim bemagga uvemassa uvevia. ketzad. im nichnas kezayit mehen levayit tahor nitma kol asher babbayit meadam vechelim shekkullan metammein bevia keadam metzora vechullan asurin bahanaa. veim serafan veasa mehen sid hare ze asur bahanaa shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 14 44)</small> "tzaraat mameret" ten bo meera veal tehane bo. vechullan meshallechin otan chutz lair af al pi sheenah mukkefet choma: 
Bayit musgar eno metamme ella mittocho shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 14 46)</small> "vehabba el habbayit kol yeme hisgir oto yitma ad haarev". aval hammuchlat metamme mittocho umeachorav shehannogea bo meachorav tame shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 14 44)</small> "tzaraat mameret" <small>(Vayikra 14 44)</small> "babbayit tame hu" vechi tahor haya ella lehosif lo tuma al tumato sheyyihye kullo tame vitamme meachorav. vechen avanim sheyyesh bahen hannega bemusgar metammein meachorehen: 
Echad hammusgar vehammuchlat metamme bevia. ketzad. bayit shehaya mesech al gabbe bayit menugga ben muchlat ben musgar o ilan shehu mesech alav haomed tachat hailan o hannichnas labbayit hachitzon tame. shehare hu vehabbayit hattame tachat ohel echad. vechen even menuggaat hannichneset leohel vehuncha sham nitma kol asher baohel. hayta munnachat tachat hailan vehattahor over nitma. haya hattahor omed tachat hailan veavar adam beeven menuggaat lo timmeahu. veim hinnichah sham timmeahu shemmoshav hamenugga kamohu ben adam ben kelim ben avanim veetzav vaafaro: 
Hammaahil beyado al even menuggaat o sheheehila alav tahor ad sheyyigga: 
Tahor shennichnas levayit menugga derech achorav afillu nichnas kullo chutz mechatmo tahor shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 14 46)</small> "vehabba el habbayit" derech bia timmea tora: 
Tahor shehichnis rosho verubbo levayit tame nitma. vechen tallit tehora shehichnis mimmenna shalosh al shalosh levayit tame nitmet. vechen keli cheres shehichnis aviro levayit tame nitma. aval shear kelim ad sheyyachnis rov hakkelim, mishsheyyachnis rubbo nitma miyyad. bamme devarim amurim bechelim shennichnesu chalutzin. aval adam miyyisrael shennichnas levayit menugga vehu lavush bivgadav vesandalav beraglav vetabbeotav beyadav hare haadam tame miyyad. uvegadav tehorim ad sheyyashhe sham kede sheyyasev adam veyochal keshalosh betzim pat chittim beliftan shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 14 47)</small> "vehashshochev babbayit yechabbes et begadav vehaochel babbayit yechabbes et begadav". vechi taale al datecha sheen begadav mittammein ad sheyyochal sham. ella litten shiur lashshochev keochel. veachad hashshochev o hayyoshev o haomed im shaha kede leechol shiur achila haamura nitmeu begadav: 
Mi shennichnas levayit menugga vechelav al ketefav vesandalo vetabbato bechappav hu vehen temein miyyad sheeno matztzil milletamme miyyad ella kelim shehu lavush bahen. vechen haakkum vehabbehema shehayu levushin bechelim venichnesu labbayit hamenugga nitmeu hakkelim miyyad. aval haakkum eno mekabbel tuma kivhema: 
Mi shehaya omed bevayit menugga ufashat yadav chutz labbayit vetabbeotav beyadav im shaha kede achilat hashshiur nitmeu hattabbaot af al pi shehem bachutz. vechen haomed bachutz ufashat yado levayit menugga nitmeu yadav bilvad miyyad. veim nishtahu sham kede achilat hashshiur nitmeu tabbeotav veim lav tehorot: 
Kol hammatztzil betzamid patil beohel hammet matztzil mechusse bevayit menugga. vechol hammatztzil mechusse beohel hammet afillu haya megulle bevayit hamenugga hare ze tahor. ketzad. kele cheres o kele avanim uchele adama vechayyotze bahen shehayu ochalin umashkin vechelim betochan vehayu mechussin bevayit hamenugga af al pi sheenan mukkafin tzamid patil hen vechol ma shebbetochan tahor. habbor vehaddut shebbevayit hamenugga af al pi shehen megullin kelim shebbetochan tehorin: 
Hatztzaraat hu shem haamur beshuttafut kolel inyanim harebe sheen domin ze laze. shehare loven or haadam karuy tzaraat. unefilat ketzat sear harosh o hazzakan karuy tzaraat. veshinnuy en habbegadim o habbattim karuy tzaraat. veze hashshinnuy haamur babbegadim uvabbattim shekkeraattu tora tzaraat beshuttafut hashshem eno mimminhago shel olam ella ot ufele haya beyisrael kede lehazehiran millashon hara. shehamesapper belashon hara mishtannot kirot beto. im chazar bo yithar habbayit. im amad berisho ad shehuttatz habbayit mishtannin kele haor shebbeveto shehu yoshev veshochev alehen. im chazar bo yitharu. veim amad berisho ad sheyyissarfu mishtannin habbegadim shealav. im chazar bo yitharu veim amad berisho ad sheyyissarfu mishtanne oro veyitztarea veyihye muvdal umefursam levaddo ad shello yitassek besichat harshaim shehu halletzanut velashon hara. veal inyan ze mazhir battora veomer <small>(Devarim 24 8)</small> "hishshamer benega hatztzaraat" <small>(Devarim 24 9)</small> "zachor et asher asa Adonai elohecha lemiryam badderech". hare hu omer hitbonnu ma era lemiryam hannevia sheddibbera beachiha shehayta gedola mimmennu beshanim vegidlattu al birkeha vesikkena beatzmah lehatztzilo min hayyam vehi lo dibbera bignuto ella taata shehishvattu lishar neviim vehu lo hikpid al kol haddevarim haellu shenneemar <small>(Bamidbar 12 3)</small> "vehaish moshe anav meod" veaf al pi chen miyyad neensha betzaraat. kal vachomer livne adam harshaim hattippeshim shemmarbim ledabber gedolot veniflaot. lefichach rauy lemi sherotze lechavven archotav lehitrachek mishivatan umilledabber immahen kede shello yittafes adam bereshet reshaim vesichlutam. veze derech yeshivat halletzim harshaim battechilla marbin bedivre havay kainyan shenneemar <small>(Kohelet 5 2)</small> "vekol kesil berov devarim". umittoch kach bain lesapper bignut hatztzaddikim kainyan shenneemar <small>(Tehillim lo 19)</small> "tealamna sifte shaker haddovrot al tzaddik atak". umittoch kach yihye lahen hergel ledabber banneviim velatet dofi bedivrehem kainyan shenneemar <small>(divrei hayamim 2 36 16)</small> "vayyihyu malivim bemalache haelohim uvozim devarav umittateim binviav". umittoch kach bain ledabber belohim vechofrin baikkar kainyan shenneemar <small>(Melachim 2 17 9)</small> "vaychappeu vene yisrael devarim asher lo chen al Adonai elohehem". vahare hu omer <small>(Tehillim 73 9)</small> "shattu vashshamayim pihem uleshonam tihalach baaretz" mi garam lahem lashit bashshamayim pihem leshonam shehalcha techilla baaretz. zo hi sichat harshaim sheggoremet lahen yeshivat keranot vishivat kenesiyyot shel amme haaretz vishivat batte mishtaot im shote shechar. aval sichat keshere yisrael enah ella bedivre tora vechachma. lefichach hakkadosh baruch hu ozer al yadan umezakke otan bah. shenneemar <small>(Malachi 3 16)</small> "az nidberu yire Adonai ish el reehu vayyakshev Adonai vayyishma vayyikkatev sefer zikkaron lefanav leyire Adonai ulechoshve shemo": seliku lehu hilchot tumat tzaraat
Mishneh Torah, Those Who Defile Bed or S: Hazzav vehazzava vehannidda vehayyoledet kol echad mearbatan av meavot hattumot. metammein kelim bemagga. umetamme adam bemagga uvemassa. umetamme mishkav umoshav umerkav mittachtav veose otan av tuma. umetamme maddaf al gabbo:
Echad zava ketanna veechad zava gedola. veechad zava mechamat atzmah o mechamat ones. veechad zav baal shete reiot o baal shalosh. tumat kullan shava letamme acherim:
Ketanna bat yom echad mittammea benidda. bat asara yamim beziva. bat shalosh shanim veyom echad metammea et boalah kemo sheyyitbaer:
Katan ben yom echad mittamme beziva. veechad gerim vaavadim veechad yisrael mittammein benidda uveziva:
Seris adam seris chamma mittammein beziva kishar habberiin:
En haishsha mittammea beloven velo haish beodem ella haishsha beodem vehaish beloven:

Tumtum veanderoginus notnin alehem chumre haish vechumre haishsha. mittammein beloven keish uveodem keishsha. vetumatan besafek lefichach en sorfin alehen teruma vekadashim veen chayyavin alehen al tumat mikdash vekadashav. raa loven veodem keachad sorfin alehen et hatteruma veet hakkadashim aval en chayyavin alehen al biat mikdash vekadashav shenneemar <small>(Bamidbar 5 3)</small> "mizzachar ad nekeva teshallechu" ad sheyyihye hattuma tumat zachar vadday o tumat nekeva vaddait. vechen hannogea balloven veodem shello keachat eno chayyav al tumat mikdash vekadashav. naga hu beatzmo beloven veodem sheraa hare ze chayyav al biat hammikdash:

Dam hannidda o dam hazzava o dam hayyoledet metamme bechol shehu bemagga uvemassa shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 15 33)</small> "vehaddava beniddatah vehazzav" mippi hashshemua lamdu shemmadve kamoha. uchevar bearnu beinyan issur nidda shechamishsha damim temeim baishsha aval im raata dam yarok hare hu tahor veeno kemo rukkah ushear mashkin hayyotzin mimmenna sheharok mitaggel veyotze veze shotet veyored:

Ishsha sheyyatza havvalad middafnah veyotze immo dam min haddofen hare oto dam av meavot hattumot kedam hannidda vehalleda vehazziva shehammakor mekomo tame. vehaishsha tehora ad sheyyetze mimmenna dam derech harechem:

Mekor haishsha shenneekar venafal laaretz haishsha temea tumat erev vechen makor shehizzia kishne tippe margaliyyot haishsha temea tumat erev. aval enah nidda ad shettire echad mechamishsha damim hametammein otah:
Hezia tippa achat hare haishsha tehora sheenah ella michutz lammakor:

Zovo shel zav av meavot hattumot kezav shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 15 2)</small> "zovo tame hu" umetamme bemagga uvemassa bechol shehu. reiyya rishona shel zav enah metammea bemassa vahare hi keshichvat zera ben meish gadol ben meish katan vechen hammishkavot vehammoshavot sheyyashav alehem mishsheraa reiyya rishona ad sheraa hashsheniyya tehorim sheeno karuy zav ella achar reiyya sheniyya kemo shebbearnu behilchot mechussere kappara. raa achat merubba kishtayim en tame ella hammesit tippa acharona:

Reiyya rishona shel metzora metamme bemassa shenneemar <small>(Bamidbar 5 2)</small> "kol tzarua vechol zav vechol tame lanafesh" hare hatztzarua kezav gamur ma zav gamur zovo metamme bemassa af metzora reiyyato harishona metamme bemassa:

Rok hazzav veshichvat zaro umeme raglav kol echad mishshelashtan av tuma din tora. umetamme bechol shehu bemagga uvemassa hare hu omer berok <small>(Vayikra 15 8)</small> "vechi yarok hazzav battahor". umeme raglav veshichvat zaro i efshar shello yihye bahem tzichtzuche ziva kol shehu:
Echad zav veechad nidda veyoledet vezava kol echad mehen rukko umeme raglav av tuma kezav. vechen kol makom shenneemar bahalachot ellu hazzav echad hazzav veechad shear haarbaa:

Tisha mashkin bezav shelosha mehen av tuma vehen rukko veshichvat zaro umeme raglav. kol echad meellu metamme adam vechelim bechol shehu kemo shebbearnu. shelosha mehen kivlad hattuma veellu hen dimat eno vedam maggafto vachalev haishsha. kol echad meellu kemashkin temein sheen metammein adam aval metammein kelim middivre sofrim kemo shebbearnu. ushelosha mehen tehorin veellu hen zeato velecha serucha hayyotzim mimmennu veharei. hare ellu shelosha min hazzav vachaverav kemotan mishshear haadam. kicho venio veriro ume haaf shello hare hen kerukko lechol davar uvichlal harok hen chashuvin. dam hayyotze mippi amma vedam hashshotet mippiv hare hen bichlal dam maggafto. haya motzetz verokek dam hare ze metamme kerok. shehaddam shemmotzetz i efshar lo belo tzichtzuche rok:

Dam nidda vezava veyoledet metamme lach veyavesh aval zovo shel zav verukko veshichvat zaro eno metamme ella kol zeman shehu lach aval yavesh yoter midday eno metamme. vead kamma. im shorin oto befoshrin meet leet vechozer lichmot shehaya hare ze metamme kelach im hayu hammayim poshrin bitchillatan af al pi sheenan poshrin besofan. vechol haddevarim haellu divre kabbala hen:
Pishtan shettevaattu nidda hammesito tahor. veim haya lach metamme mippene rok piha:
Zav shehinniach piv al pi hakkos venimlach shello lishtoto hammesit et hakkos tahor. shata mimmennu hazzav kol shehu hammesito tame mippene mashke pi hazzav:
Zav shennashach et happat veet habbatzal hammesitan tahor. nashach et hakkishshut vehammelaffon hammesitan tame mippene mashke pi hazzav hammitarev bahen:
Kelippe polin ukelippe tormosin shekketzatzan haakkum hammesitan tame shekkol akkum kezavim lechol divrehen kemo sheyyitbaer. hakkelippin shebbashshevakin holchin bahen achar harov:

Dam tame shennitarev bemayim im batlu marav hakkol tahor. nitarev bedam tahor uveyayin roin oto keillu hu mayim. vechen rok tame shennitarev bemayim im haya karush kivriyyato hare ze tame veim nimcha bemayim im batlu marav hakkol tahor. nitarev berok acher roin oto keillu hu mayim. vechen me raglav shel tame shennitarvu bemayim im batlu marehen hakkol tahor veim lav tame. nitarev beyayin o beme raglayim tehorin roin oto keillu hu mayim. nitarvu beme raglayim shel akkum holchin achar harov. ketzad. keli shehayu yisrael veakkum metilin sham me raglehen im rov akkum hakkol tame veim rov yisrael hakkol tahor mechetza lemechetza hakkol tame. vechen im nitarev me ragle akkum ze beme ragle yisrael ze holchin achar harov:
Shoalin [kele] me raglayim mikkol makom veen choshshin shemma shel niddot hen shello nechshedu benot yisrael lechannes et me raglehen keshehen niddot:

Cheres shehaya hazzav o hazzava metilin bo me raglehen vechibbesu paam rishona usheniyya hare hammashkin shekkibbesu bahen temein ufaam shelishit tehorin ben shekkibbesu bemayim ben shekkibbesu beme raglayim shehare lo nishar bah lachluchit meme raglayim:

Zava shenneekru meme ragleha besof shivat yeme hassefira veyarda vetavla vehetila mayim achar hattevila hare hen safek im achar akira holchin vezava hayta o achar hayetzia shehi tehora. vechen akkum shenneekru meme ragleha venitgayyera vetavla vehetila mayim achar shettavla hare ze safek im achar akira holchin vahare hen keme ragle haakkum hattemeim o achar yetzia vahare hem kememe ragle yisrael hattehorim:

Haavadim metammein beziva uvenidda uveleda keyisrael aval haakkum en metammein lo beziva velo beniddut velo beledot din tora shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 15 2)</small> "dabberu el bene yisrael vaamartem alehem ish ish ki yihye zav" bene yisrael metammein beziva velo haakkum. vachachamim gazru al kol haakkum sheyyetammeu kezavim lechol divrehen zecharim unekevot vehu sheyyihye hazzachar ben tesha shanim veyom echad ulemala vehannekeva bat shalosh shanim veyom echad vamala. aval hakketannim lematta mizzeman ze lo gazru alehen tuma sheikkar haggezera hi kede shello yehe tinok yisrael ragil etzel haakkum bemishkav zachur ufachot mizzeman ze en biatan bia. beet sheggazru alehen lo gazru al shichvat zera shellahen ella shichvat zaro shel akkum tehora kedin tora. umippene ma lo gazru aleha tuma kede lehodia shettumatan middivre sofrim shehare hakkol yodin sheillu hayu zavin din tora hayta shichvat zaram av hattuma keshichvat zera hazzav umeachar sheyyodin betumatan shehayta middivre sofrim lo yavou lisrof aleha teruma vekadashim. nimtzeta lamed shezzovo shel akkum. vedam nidda o dam ziva veledah shel bat akkum. uvat akkum veakkum atzman af al pi shehem nekiyyim min hattora middam hazzav. verok haakkum umeme raglehen umishkavan umerkavan. uvoel akkum. kol echad meellu av tuma middivre sofrim. lefichach en chayyavin alehen al biat mikdash vekadashav veen sorfin alehen et hatteruma. vechullan metammein adam vechelim bemagga umetammein adam bemassa kezav lechol davar. ella shehattuma middivrehen kemo shebbearnu. vedam hannachrit kerukkah uchememe ragleha metamme lach veeno metamme yavesh:
Boel nidda kenidda shehu av meavot hattuma shel tora metamme kelim bemagga umetamme adam bemassa uvemagga umetamme behesset umetamme mishkav umerkav kenidda:

En mishkav boel nidda umerkavo kemishkav nidda umerkavah shehammishkav o hammerkav sheddarsa alav nidda av meavot hattuma umishkav boel nidda umerkavo velad tuma kechelim shennogea bahen sheenan metammein adam velo kelim ella ochalin umashkin bilvad. velamma nigrea tumat mishkavo mittumat mishkavah mippene shenneemar bevoel nidda <small>(Vayikra 15 24)</small> "utehi niddatah alav vetame shivat yamim" veneemar bo <small>(Vayikra 15 24)</small> "kol hammishkav asher yishkav alav yitma" meachar shenneemar utehi niddatah alav eni yodea shehu metamme mishkav velamma neemar. mippi hashshemua lamdu shehakkatuv nitteko mittuma chamura milletamme adam vechelim utelao betuma kalla sheyyihye mishkavo valad velo yetamme adam vechelim ella ochalin umashkin bilvad kishar valdot hattumot:

Echad habba al hannidda o al shomeret yom keneged yom o al hayyoledet [ben kedarkan ben shello kedarkan] echad hameare veechad haggomer ben gadol shebba al hakketanna ben katan shebba al haggedola mittamme mishshum boel nidda. bamme devarim amurim keshehaya habboel ben tesha shanim veyom echad vehannivelet hayta bat shalosh shanim veyom echad. aval pachot mikkan eno mittamme mishshum boel nidda ella mishshum nogea benidda bilvad shehu valad veeno av. vechen boel hazzav hare hu kenogea bo veechad hannogea bezav o hannivelet min hazzav:

Hannidda vehazzava veshomeret yom keneged yom vehayyoledet af al pi shello raata dam kullam metammeot lemafrea meet leet o mippekida lifkida vezehu hannikra meet leet shebbenidda. ketzad. ishsha shehayta tehora veen lah veset uvadka atzmah beshacharit umatza tehora uvachatzi hayyom badka atzma umatza dam hare kol hattohorot sheasta mishsheat pekida rishona ad sheat pekida sheniyya temeot lemafrea. vechen im badka hayyom umatza tehora uleachar shenayim o shelosha yamim badka umatza dam kol hattohorot sheasta meet shebbadka umatza dam ad 24 shaot temeot lemafrea. veed shelleachar hattashmish hare hu kifkida veshellifne hattashmish eno kifkida mippene sheenah bodeket bo yafe:

Ishsha sheyyesh lah veset veraata dam bishat vestah dayyah sheatah veenah temea lemafrea. higgia sheat vestah velo badka atzmah uleachar yamim badka atzmah umatza dam hare zo temea lemafrea vahare hi bechezkat nidda mishsheat vestah. vezo hi tumat vestot haamura bechol makom. veim matza atzmah tehora keshebbadka achar havveset hare zo tehora:

Kol ishsha sheyyesh lah veset targish beatzmah. mefaheket. o mitatteshet. o chosheshet pi keresah veshippule meeha. o achazah tzamrurit. o roshah kaved aleha o evareha kevedin vechayyotze beellu. veyesh ishsha sheddarkah lirot beet sheyyatchil bah mikre echad meellu miyyad bitchillato veyesh ishsha shettamtin bemikre ze shaa o shetayim veachar kach tire haddam besof havveset. hayta lemuda lihyot roa bitchillat havveset kol hattohorot sheasta betoch havveset temeot. hayta lemuda lihyot roa besof havveset kol hattohorot sheasta betoch havveset tehorot. veenah chosheshet ella mishshaa sheddarkah lirot ad et shemmatza dam:

Haroa ketem temea lemafrea ad et happekida. vechen habbeged shennimtza alav hakketem tame lemafrea. vead kamma. ad shettomar badakti hechaluk hazze velo haya alav ketem. afillu kibbesattu velo bedakattu tame mikkodem hakkibbus lemafrea ad sheat bedika. vaafillu nimtza hakketem lach hare ze metamme lemafrea ad sheat habbedika sheani omer miyyamim haya sham veatta naflu alav mayim venaasa lach:

Vechol hannashim sheddayyan sheatan kitman kiriyyatan veeno metamme otan lemafrea. kol ellu hannashim hattemeot lemafrea ben raata dam ben matzata ketem metammeot mishkav umerkav lemafrea letamme adam uvegadim. vechen rukkan umeme raglehen temein lemafrea. vaafillu keli cheres hammukkaf tzamid patil metammeot otan lemafrea. aval enan metammeot et habboel lemafrea mishshum boel nidda ella mishshum nogea bilvad. aval haroa ketem habboel otah meachar shennimtzet hakketem tame mishshum boel nidda:

Meubberet shehotzi haubbar et yado vehechezirah immo temea ledah. vetumat yoledet (14) vetumat meet leet o mippekida lifkida lemafrea kemo shebbearnu vetumat vesatot vetumat ketamim hakkol middivre sofrim vetumatan missafek lefichach en sorfin alehen teruma vekadashim ella tolin. vechen chullin shennaasu al tohorat hakkodesh shennitmeu beellu tolin. aval hannaasim al tohorat hatteruma vechullin hattevulin lechalla en mittammein bechol ellu hattumot shehen middivrehen. nimtzeta omer shekkol achat meellu hannashim umishkavan umerkavan verukkan umeme raglehen uvoel roa ketem meachar shennimtza hakketem uvoel yoledet meachar sheyyatza haevar vechazar kullan avot tumot middivre sofrim:

Arba nashim dayyan sheatan veenan mittammeot lemafrea. veellu hen meubberet umenika uvetula uzekena. e zo hi meubberet mishsheyyukkar ubbarah. hayta bechezkat meubberet veraata dam veachar kach hippila ruach o davar sheeno valad hare zo bechezkatah vedayyah sheatah. raata dam veachar kach hukkar ubbarah hare zo mittammea lemafrea kechol hannashim. e zo hi menika kol arbaa veesrim chodesh miyyom halleda afillu met benah betoch zeman ze o sheggemalathu o netanathu lemenika dayyah sheatah. aval achar arbaa veesrim chodesh af al pi shehi menika veholechet hare zo temea lemafrea kechol hannashim. e zo hi betula kol shello raata dam miyyameha. betulat damim amru lo betulat betulim. ketzad. afillu nisset veraata dam mechamat nissuin o yalda veraata dam mechamat leda adayin hi betula leinyan tuma vedayya sheatah. e zo hi zekena kol sheavru aleha shelosha chodashim samuch leziknutah velo raata dam. vee zo hi samuch leziknutah kol shechavroteha korot lah zekena befaneha veenah makpedet. avru aleha shalosh onot veraata vechazru veavru aleha shalosh onot acherot o pachot o yeter veraata hare hi kechol hannashim umittammea lemafrea:
Betula sheraata dam afillu shofaat kol shiva o dolefet hare ze paam achat. raata dam ufaska vechazra veraata hare ze shete peamim:

Tinoket shello higgia zemannah lirot veraata dam paam rishona usheniyya dayyah sheatah. raata paam shelishit mittammea lemafrea. [avru aleha shelosha chodashim veachar kach raata dayyah sheatah]. avru aleha shelosha chodashim acherim veachar kach raata dayyah sheatah. avru aleha shelosha chodashim acherim veraata mittammea lemafrea:

Tinoket shehiggia zemannah lirot veraata paam rishona dayyah sheatah sheniyya mittammea lemafrea. avru aleha shelosha chodashim veachar kach raata dayyah sheatah. avru aleha shelosha chodashim acherim veachar kach raata mittammea lemafrea:

Meubberet umenika uzekena uvetula shehiggia zemannam lirot sherau reiyya rishona dayyan sheatan. rau paam sheniyya mittammeot lemafrea kechol hannashim kemo shebbearnu. veim rau harishona beones af bashsheniyya dayyan sheatan:

Meubberet o menika sheraata haddam veavru aleha shelosha chodashim veachar kach raata dayyah sheatah. avru aleha shelosha chodashim acherim veraata paam sheniyya shehi shelishit liriyya rishona mittammeot lemafrea. haroa dam achar dam tohar betoch 24 shaot dayyah sheatah. vechol sheddayyah sheatah af al pi sheenah mittammea lemafrea tzericha shettivdok atzmah tamid. vechol ishsha hammarba livdok meshubbachat chutz min hannidda veyoshevet al dam tohar sheen habbedika moelet lahen kelum:

Chachamim tikkenu lahen livnot yisrael lihyot bodkot atzman bechol yom beshacharit mippene tohorot shel arvit uvearvit mippene tohorot shel shacharit. vechol ochelet teruma bodeket beshaa sheochelet bitruma. vechol ishsha bodeket beshaa sheoveret leshammesh mittatah mippene hattohorot. aval im lo hayta oseket betohorot enah tzericha bedika levaalah shekkol hannashim sheyyesh lahen veset bechezkat tohora levalehen kemo shebbearnu beinyan nidda:
Chezkat benot yisrael shello higgiu lefirkan bechezkat tohora veen hannashim bodkot otan. aval mishshehiggiu lefirkan tzerichot bedika venashim bodkot otan:
Hachereshet vehashshota umi shennitrefa datah becholi im yesh lahen pikchot metakkenot otan hare ellu ochlot bitruma:

Kol hakketamim habbaim mibben yisrael bechezkat tuma vehabbaim mibben haakkum bechezkat tehorin. vehannimtzaim beare yisrael tehorim shello nechshedu yisrael lehashelich kitmehen ella matzniin otam. lefichach kol hakketamin hannimtzaim bechol makom tehorin chutz min hannimtzaim bachorim usevivot bet hattuma. vechullan tumatan besafek kemo shebbearnu:

Kol hakketamim hattemein maavirin alehen shiva sammanin veachar kach ben avar hakketem ben lo avar matbilo vetahor. sheim lo avar kelal hare hu tzeva. veim avar o keha hare ze ketem umeachar sheavru alav hassammanin kevar batel af al pi sherishshumo nikkar. vaafillu ketem shel dam niddut vadday kevan sheheevir alav shiva sammanim batel umatbilo veose tohorot al gabbav:
Beged sheavad bo ketem maavirin al kol habbeged shiva sammanim umatbilo. avda bo shichvat zera im haya chadash bodko bemachat veim haya shachuk bodko bachamma:

Beged shehaya alav ketem vehitbilo veasa al gabbav tohorot veachar kach heevir al hakketem shiva hassammanim velo avar hare ze tzeva vehattohorot sheasa tehorot veen tzarich lehatebilo paam acheret. veim avar hakketem o keha eno hare ze ketem vehattohorot temeot. shehare hikpid al hakketem lahasiro. vetzarich lehatebilo paam sheniyya letaharo:

Ketem sheheevir alav shishsha sammanim velo avar veachar kach heevir alav tzefon veavar hare hattohorot shennaasu al gabbav temeot. af al pi shehatztzefon maavir hatztzeva hoil velo heevir alav shiva hassammanin hare ze bechezkat ketem. veshemma illu heevir hashshevii haya over. heevir alav shivat hassammanim velo avar vechazar veheeviran alav paam sheniyya veavar kol hattohorot shennaasu al gabbav ben tichboset rishona lashsheniyya tehorot. vechol hattohorot shennaasu al gabbav achar tichboset sheniyya temeot. hoil vegilla dato shehu makpid alav verotze lehotzi rishshumo hare ze tame ad sheyyevattelo veyatbilo. kevar bearnu behilchot issure bia shiva hassammanin shemmaavirin al hakketem ma hen veheach maavirin otan:

Haishsha shemmeta veyatza mimmenna dam metamme mishshum ketem shehammakor mekomo tame. af al pi sheyyatza haddam achar shemmeta veen kan nidda hoil umimmakom tame yatza metamme tumat ketamim. veim haya bo reviit metamme beohel umetamme mishshum ketem:

Hazzav vehazzava vehannidda vehayyoledet leolam hem betumatan umetammein adam vechelim umishkav umerkav ad sheyyitbolu. afillu nitacharu kamma shanim belo reiyyat tuma velo tavlu hare hen betumatan: 
Yoledet shello tavla achar shiva lezachar vearbaa asar linkeva kol dam shettire af al pi shehu betoch yeme tohar hare hu kedam hanniddot umetamme lach veyavesh. lo tala hakkatuv beyamim bilvad ella beyamim utevila: 
Yoledet sheyyarda litbol mittuma letohora veneekar mimmenna dam biridatah veyatza chutz leven hashshinnayim hare zo temea veen hattevila moelet ledam ze veaf al pi sheadayin hi bivsarah. veim neekar mimmenna baaliyyatah min hammikve hare zo tehora mippene shehu dam tohar. vehattevila moelet lechol haddam hammuvla baevarim umesima oto dam tohar: 
Yoledet shettavla achar shiva shel zachar vearbaa asar shel nekeva o achar sefirat shiva yamim nekiyyim im hayta yoledet bezov hare hi bechol yeme tohar shellah ketame shettaval vaadayin lo heeriv shimsho vahare hi tevulat yom bechol otan hayyamim. veenah tzericha tevila acheret besof yeme tohar ella bemishlam hayyamim hare hi kitvul yom sheheeriv shimsho. bamme devarim amurim shehi kitvul yom leinyan teruma umaaser. aval lekadashim hare hi kerishon letuma sheadayin lo taval ella kemi shennaga benidda o bitme met sheadayin lo taval vechayyotze bahen. nimtzeta atta lamed shehayyoledet betoch yeme tohar ochelet bemaaser ufoselet et hatteruma kitvul yom kemo sheyyitbaer. veim nafal merukkah umiddam tohoratah al kikkar shel teruma hare hu betohorato shemmashke tevul yom tahor kemo sheyyitbaer. umetammea et hakkadashim kivlad hattumot ad shettashlim yeme tohar vetihye tehora lakkol. veyerae li shemmeachar shehi metammea et hakkodesh shehi tzericha tevila acheret bassof veachar kach tigga bakkodesh af al pi sheenah tzericha tevila acheret laachilat hatteruma: 
Yoledet shehi metzoraat vetavla achar shiva shel zachar o arbaa asar shel nekeva hare dam tohar shellah tame kerukkah uchememe ragleha. vechullan kemashkin temein shekkol hammashkin hattemein hayyotzin mehen kemashkin shehen nogin bahen. chutz mizzav vechayyotze bo. shehare shelosha mashkin hayyotzin mimmennu avot tumot kemo shebbearnu: 
Zava ketanna shettavla bayyom hashshimmur shellah achar hanetz kemo shebbearnu beinyan issur nidda hare maggaah uveilatah teluyim. im nigmar hayyom velo raata kol shennaga bo tahor uvoalah tahor ufatur. veim raata dam achar shettavla kol tohorot sheasta temeot veosat mishkav umerkav uvoalah chayyav chattat. tavla belel hashshimmur kodem sheyyaale ammud hashshachar hare zo kemi shello tavla vaadayin osat merkav umoshav: 
Haroa dam beyom achad asar vetavla leerev lel shenem asar hare zo metammea mishkav umoshav. af al pi sheenah reuya lihyot zava gedola kemo shebbearnu beinyan issur nidda: 
Tavla beyom shenem asar achar hanetz hachamma af al pi sheasura leshammesh [ad] laerev im shimmesha boalah tahor umishkavah umerkavah tehorin af al pi sheraata dam beyom shenem asar achar hattevila. mippene shehu techillat nidda kemo shebbearnu sham beissur nidda veeno mitztaref leyom achad asar lefichach enah tzericha lishmor yom shenem asar ella tovelet veoseket betohorot. aval haroa dam baasiri tovelet beyom achad asar umeshammeret oto sheim tire bo dam achar tevila nitmeu kol tohorot sheasta venitma boalah af al pi sheenah reuya lihyot zava gedola kemo shebbearnu beinyan nidda: 
Zav vezava gedola shettavlu beyom shevii shellahen kemo shebbearnu lo yitasseku betohorot ad laerev shemma yiru tuma veyissetru shivat yeme hassefira venimtza otan hattohorot temeot lemafrea. af al pi shehen osin mishkav umoshav lemafrea en metammein kele cheres behesset meachar shettavlu af al pi shechazru verau tuma vesatru hakkol. vechol keli cheres shehesitu ad shello rau tahor:

Kevar bearnu shehazzav vachaverav metammein mishkav umoshav umerkav. vehammishkav vehammoshav echad hu velamma neemar battora <small>(Vayikra 15 4)</small> "mishkav umoshav" shehammishkav harauy lishchiva vehammoshav harauy lishiva. uven sheyyashav al hammishkav o sheshshachav al hammoshav timmeahu lefichach ani omer bechol makom mishkav levad vehu haddin lemoshav. vee zehu merkav ze harauy lirchiva kegon mirdaat hachamor vetappitan hassus: 
Hammishkav vehammerkav kol echad mehen av meavot hattumot shel tora metammein adam vechelim bemagga umetammein et haadam bemassa. uma ben mishkav lemerkav shehannogea bemishkav im haya adam venaga bivgadim uvishar kelim ad shello perash mimmetammeav hare ze timmeam vaasaan rishon letuma vehannogea bemerkav eno metamme begadim velo kelim afillu bishat maggao aval hannose et hammishkav o et hammerkav hare ze metamme begadim ushear kelim bishat nesiato ad shello peresh mimmetammeav. uminnayin shebbetumat merkav chalak maggao mimmassao uvemishkav lo chalak. shehare hu omer bemishkav <small>(Vayikra 15 5)</small> "veish asher yigga bemishkavo yechabbes begadav" uvemerkav hu omer <small>(Vayikra 15 9)</small> "vechol hammerkav asher yirkav alav" <small>(Vayikra 15 10)</small> "vechol hannogea bechol asher yihye tachtav yitma ad haarev". velo nomar bo yechabbes begadav melammed sheeno metamme begadim bishat maggao veneemar <small>(Vayikra 15 10)</small> "vehannose otam yechabbes begadav" echad hannose et hammerkav o hannose mishkav metamme begadim bishat nesiato. nimtzeta lamed shehazzav vehazzava vehannidda vehayyoledet umishkavan verukkan umeme raglehen vedam nidda vezava veyoledet vezovo shel zav kol echad meellu av. veadam shennaga beechad mikkol ellu o nesaan metamme begadim ushear kelim bishat negiato o bishat nesiato. veeno metamme lo adam velo kele cheres. shekkol hametamme adam metamme kele cheres vechol sheeno metamme adam eno metamme kele cheres. hinne lamadta shekkol tame shenneemar bo yechabbes begadav hare ze metamme begadim sheyyigga bahem kol zeman shello perash mimmetammeav veose otan rishon letuma kamohu. umetamme shear kelim kivgadim. chutz mikkeli cheres sheeno metamme lo adam velo kele cheres af al pi sheadayin lo perash. vechol tame shello neemar bo yechabbes begadav hare hu ad shello perash keachar shepperash sheeno metamme begadim mippene shehu valad veen tzarich lomar sheeno metamme adam velo kele cheres. ulefichach hannogea bemerkav eno metamme begadim bishat maggao vehannose et hammerkav metamme begadim bishat nesiato kemo shebbearnu: 
Kol hakkelim sheyyinnasu lemala min hazzav hem hannikrain maddaf vehem kullam kechelim shehu nogea bahem shehem rishon letuma veenan metammein lo adam velo kelim aval metammein ochalin umashkin kishar valdot hattuma. vetumat maddaf middivrehem: 
Hazzav vehazzava vehannidda vehayyoledet vehametzora shemmetu hare hen metammein mishkav umerkav achar mitatan keshehayu keshehen chayyin ad sheyyimmok habbasar. vetuma zo middivrehem gezera shemma yitallef echad meellu vidammu shemmet vehu adayin lo met. nimtza mishkavo umerkavo shel achar mita av tuma shel divre sofrim. aval nachri shemmet eno ose mishkav shehare keshehu chay eno metamme ella middivrehem kemo shebbearnu: 
Kol makom shaatta shomea tumat mishkav umerkav eno sheyyigga hattame bammishkav o bammerkav kesheyyinnase alehen ella afillu hayu avanim gedolot lemala min hakkeli heasuy lemishkav o lemerkav venissa hazzav al haavanim millemala nitma hammishkav o hammerkav venaasa av tuma afillu elef mishkav o merkav ze lemala mizze veeven al haelyon veyashav echad mimmetammee mishkav umoshav lemala min haeven nitmeu hakkol. veechad hammishkav hannogea baaretz o hammishkav shel mala im naga bo bishat shechivato kol echad mehen av hattuma. vechen im haya echad mimmetammee mishkav umoshav lematta veeven al gabbav voochalin umashkin vechelim veadam al gabbe haeven ze lemala mizze kullan temein verishon letuma. veechad keli o ochel umashke o adam hannogea bezav. o keli o ochel umashke o adam shehu lemala al haeven sheal gabbav. hakkol velad tuma. veeno metamme lo adam velo kelim chutz min haadam sheal gabbe hazzav shead shello perash mimmetammeav metamme shear kelim kemo shebbearnu: 
Hoochalim vehammashkin vehakkelim sheenan asuyim lo lemishkav velo lemoshav velo lemerkav shehayu lematta veyashav hazzav vechayyotze bo alehem lemala velo nagu bahen kullan tehorin. aval im haya haadam lematta vehazzav lemala af al pi sheeno nogea bo hare ze tame mishshum nose zav. kechol nose davar shemmetamme bemassa shehannose rishon letuma. ha lamadta shekkol sheyyihye lemala min hazzav tame ben adam uven kelim haasuyin lemishkav ulemoshav ulemerkav ben shear kol hakkelim ben ochalim ben mashkin hakkol rishon letuma. vechol sheyyihye lematta min hazzav velo yigga bo tahor. chutz min haadam o keli heasuy lemishkav o lemoshav o lemerkav. ella shehaadam rishon vehakkelim haasuyim lemoshav o lemishkav o lemerkav av hattuma kemo shebbearnu:

Hazzav metamme et hammishkav vehammoshav vehammerkav bachamishsha derachim. omed. yoshev. shochev. nitle. venishan. ketzad. keli heasuy lemishkav o lemoshav o lemerkav afillu haya tachat haeven im amad echad mimmetammee mishkav al haeven o yashav aleha o shachav o nishan aleha o nitla bah hoil venitnasse al hakkeli hazze mikkol makom nitma venaasa av tuma. vechol echad mechamishsha derachim ellu hu hannikra midras bechol makom: 
Vechen hammishkav vehammerkav metammein et haadam beshiva derachim. bachamishsha derachim ellu shemmaninu. uvemagga uvemassa. ketzad. mishkav o merkav sheddaras alav hazzav venitma bemidraso. hannogea bo o hannoso tame. vechen hayyoshev alav o haomed o hashshochev o hannitle o hannishan af al pi shehayta even mavdelet ben hattahor uven hammidras hare ze nitma shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 15 6)</small> "vehayyshev al hakkeli asher yeshev alav hazzav" mippi hashshemua lamdu shemmakom shehazzav yoshev umetamme im yashav sham hattahor nitma. ma hazzav metamme merkav umoshav shettachat haeven af hattahor mittamme min hammishkav o hammerkav shehu mittachat haeven af al pi sheen hazzav sham al hammishkav veadam ze shehu lemala min hammidras metamme begadim kol zeman shello perash mimmetammeav kemo shebbearnu: 
En hazzav metamme et hammishkav ad sheyyinnase rubbo al hammishkav o al hammoshav o al hammerkav. vechen hattahor sheddaras al midras hazzav eno mittamme mechamat hammidras ad sheyyinnase rubbo alav. aval im nissa miuto hoil velo naga hare ze tahor. ketzad. miktzat tame al hammishkav umiktzat hattahor al oto mishkav hammishkav tahor vehattahor shennasa miktzato alav tehorin. hattame shennissa rubbo al miktzat hammishkav o hammerkav nitma hammishkav kullo o hammerkav kullo. vechen hattahor shennissa rubbo al miktzat hammidras nitma veaf al pi shello nasa ella al miktzat hammoshav: 
Zav shehaya muttal al chamishsha safsalin shehen munnachin learkan temeim shehare nissa rubbo al kol echad mehen. hayu munnachin lerachban tehorin shehare lo nissa rubbo al kol echad mehen. veim yashan alehem ben kach uven kach temeim shemma nithappech alehem venimtza rubbo al kol echad. haya muttal al shishsha kelim haasuyim lemishkav. shete yadav al shenayim. ushene raglav al shenayim. verosho al echad. vegufo al echad. en tame mishshum mishkav ella ze shettachat gufo shehare nissa rubbo alav. amad al shene mishkavot raglo achat al echad veraglo sheniyya al hashsheni shenehen temein: 
Haya yoshev al gabbe hammitta vearbaa mishkavot tachat arba ragle hammitta kullan temeot mippene sheenah yechola laamod al shalosh: 
Haya rochev al gabbe behema vearbaa mishkavot tachat arba ragleha kullan tehorot. mippene shehabbehema yechola laamod al shalosh venimtzet harviit mesayyea umesayyea en bo mammash. vehoil vechol achat reuya lihyot mesayyea veen anu yodim e zo yad vee zo regel hi shello hayta nishenet aleha hare lo huchzeka tuma beachat mehen ulefichach kullan tehorot. lefichach im haya mishkav echad tachat shete yede habbehema o tachat shete ragleha o tachat yadah veraglah hare ze tame shehare vadday nissa hazzav al mishkav ze. sheen habbehema yechola laamod al shetayim: 
Yashav hattame al korat bet habbad kol hakkelim shebbaekel temeim. shehare hem retzutzim tachat hakkora. aval im yashav al machbesh shel koves hare hakkelim shettachat luach hammachbesh tehorim. mippene shehu rafuy venimtzet mishenet hammachbesh al raglav lo al hakkelim shettachtav. sheim yirtze adam lehachenis sakkin vechayyotze bah ben hakkelim shettachat hammachbesh uven hammachbesh machnis af al pi shehu kashur: 
Zav sheddaras al keli shello naasa lemishkav o lemoshav o lemerkav af al pi shehu rauy lemishkav hoil velo naga bo hare ze tahor. shehare omrim lo amod venaase melachtenu bichli ze. ketzad. kafa sea veyashav aleha kafa areva veyashav aleha o sheyyashav al parochet o al kela shel sefina vechayyotze bahen. hare ellu tehorim. shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 15 4)</small> "asher yeshev alav" hameyuchad lishiva lo sheomrim lo amod venaase melachtenu. mippene shekkeli ze lo naasa lishiva. haya hakkeli meshammesh lishiva im melachto sheose lah hare ze mittamme bemidras. kegon hardid. vehechaluk. vehattallit. vehatturemal. vehachemet. af al pi shekkol echad mehen lo naasa mittechilla lemishkav hare hu meshammesh et hammishkav im melachto. vechen kol kayyotze beellu. uvehilchot kelim avaer kol hakkelim hammittammein bemidras vechelim sheen mittammein bemidras. vee ze keli rauy lishiva. vee ze rauy lishchiva. vee ze rauy lirchiva:
Kevar bearnu bitchillat sefer ze sheim hesit haadam et hattuma shehi metammea bemassa nitma mishshum nose aval im hesita hattuma et haadam lo nitma:

En bechol avot hattumot kullan tuma sheim tasit et haadam hattahor o et hakkeli hattahor tetamme otan ella hazzav o chaverav bilvad. vezo hi hattuma hayetera bezav shello matzinu kemotah bechol hattora sheim hesit et hattehorin temein. ketzad. hayta kora muttelet al rosh haggader veadam tahor o kelim afillu keli cheres al ketzatah vehenid hazzav et hakkatze hashsheni hoil venitnadnedu mechamat hazzav hare ze kemi shennaga bahen utemein venaasu rishon letuma din tora. veen tzarich lomar sheim nasa hazzav et haadam o et hakkelim shettimmean. veechad zav vezava nidda veyoledet bechol haddevarim haellu. hinne lamadta shehaadam hattahor shehesit et hazzav nitma mishshum nose zav. vehazzav shehesit et hattahor ben adam ben kelim afillu kele cheres temein. mippene shehanadat hazzav laacherim keillu naga bahen:

Chomer behesset hazzav mimmaggao sheim naga bichli cheres hammukkaf tzamid patil tahor veim hesito timmeahu. vechen keli cheres shehu navuv kechaddur vaadayin lo naasa lo pe kemo ilpasin irniot im hesitan hazzav temeim veaf al pi shehen tehorin beohel hammet shehare hen kichli cheres hammukkaf tzamid patil sheppitcho satum. vechen machat shehayta belua betoch haetz vetabbaat habbelua betoch hallevena vehesit hazzav et haetz o hallevena nitmeu hakkelim habbeluim shebbetochan. vechen kol kayyotze baze:
Zav shehichnis yado o raglo laavir keli cheres hoil velo naga bo mittocho velo henido hare ze tahor sheen hannidda vechayyotze bah metammein leevarim:

Zav shehaya kane achuz betoch kumto vehesit vehotzi biktze hakkane adam o keli hare hen tehorin shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 15 11)</small> "vechol asher yigga bo hazzav veyadav lo shataf bammayim" mippi hashshemua lamdu shehakkatuv hazze medabber behesset hazzav vehotzio bilshon negia lomar ma negia beyadav vehaddome leyadav mishshear gufo haggaluy etzel hannegia af hesseto ad sheyyasit begaluy shebbegufo lo sheyyasit bevet hassetarim. haya hakkane bekumto shel tahor vehesit bo et hazzav tame shehammesit et hattuma kenose otah ucheshem shehannose bevet hassetarim tame kemo shebbearnu bitchillat sefer ze kach hammesit bevet hassetarim tame:

Hazzav bechaf moznayim ucheli heasuy lemishkav o lemerkav bechaf sheniyya kenegdo. kara hazzav hare hen kechelim shennaga bahen shehare hesitan. karu hen temein mishshum mishkav venaasu av shehare nasu hazzav ucheillu amad alehen. haya bechaf sheniyya shear hakkelim o ochalin umashkin o adam ben shekkaru hen ben shekkara hazzav kullan rishon letuma:

Hazzav vehattahor sheyyashvu al hassafsal o al hanneser bizman shehen machgirin. o shealu beilan shekkocho ra vehu hailan sheen boovi ikkaro kede lachok rova hakkav. o shealu besukka shekkochah ra vehu shennechba bah vedochek otah tazuz bo. o shealu besullam mitzri sheeno kavua bemasmer. o shealu al hakkevesh veal hakkora veal haddelet bizman sheenan mechubbarin betit. hare ze tame mippene shehen mitnadnedin bahen ucheillu hesit hazzav et hattahor sheimmo. aval im yashvu bisfina gedola sheenah yechola lehasit baadam. o al hanneser o al hassafsal bizman sheenam machgirin. o shealu beilan uvesukka shekkochan yafe. o besullam mitzri hakkavua bemasmer. o bechevesh uvekora uvedelet shemmechubbarim betit. afillu alu mitztzad echad hare ze tahor:

Zav vetahor shehayu shenehem keechad megifin et haddalet o potchin hare ze tahor. haya echad megif veechad poteach nitma. heelu ze et ze min habbor im hattame heela et hattahor timmeahu mippene shehesito. veim hattahor heela et hattame nitma bemassao kemo shebbearnu:

Zav vetahor shehayu mafshilin bachavalim im haya ze moshech elach veze moshech elach nitma. hayu orgin ben beomdin ben beyoshvin o tochanin o porkin min hachamor o toanin. bizman shemmassaan kaved hare ze tame veim haya massoy kal tahor:
Tahor shehaya makke et hazzav hare ze tahor. vezav shehikka et hattahor timmeahu. sheim yimmashech hattahor vahare hattame nofel venimtza keillu nishan alav. ulefichach af bigde hattahor temein:

Zav shennissa miktzato al hattahor o tahor shennissa miktzato al hazzav nitma. ketzad. etzbao shel zav shehinnichah lemala min hattahor o hattahor shehinniach etzbao lemala min hazzav af al pi sheyyesh benehen even o kora vechayyotze bahem hare ze tame. vechen chibbure hazzav shennisseu al hattahor o chibbure tahor shennisseu al hazzav hare ze tame. ucheillu nasa kol echad mehem atzmo shel chavero. veellu hem hachibburim. hashshinnayim hatztzipparnayim vehassear shellahen. veyerae li shettuma zo middivrehem:

Davar shehaya mechubbar baaretz o mesummar bemasmerim. im haya kocho yafe vechazak vehikkish alav hazzav uveet shehikkish henid keli o ochalin umashkin mikkoach hakkaato o shehippilan hare ellu tehorim. veim lo haya kocho yafe vechazak ella mitnadned vehikkish alav hazzav vehippil o henid bechoach hakkaato kelim o ochalim umashkin hare ellu temein. ucheillu hesitan shehare mikkocho naflu. ze hakkelal kol shennafal mikkoach hesseto tame. mikkoach harada tahor. ketzad. hikkish al ilan o sukka shekkochan ra. o al sullam mitzri sheeno kavua bemasmer. o al kora vedelet vechevesh sheenam mechubbarim betit. o shehikkish al hanneger al hammanul vehammashot. uveshaa shehikkish hippil ochalin umashkin o kelim afillu henidan velo naflu hare ellu temeim. aval im hikkish al ilan o al sukka shekkochan yafe. o al sullam mesummar. o al kevesh o al delet o kora hamechubbarin betit. o al hammarish. o al hattannur. uveshaa shehikkish henid kelim o ochalin umashkin afillu hippilan hare ellu tehorin. vechen kol kayyotze baellu: 
Tannur shehayta happat devuka bo vehikkish al hattannur venafal kikkar afillu haya teruma hare ze tahor. veim haya cheres min hattannur medubbak bakkikkar shennafal afillu haya chullin hare ze tame: 
En hammishkav o hammerkav metamme kelim o ochalin umashkin ella bemagga bilvad. aval im hayu kelim o ochalim umashkin lemala min hammidras o shehaya hammidras lemala mehen afillu lo hifsik benehem ella neyar hoil velo naga bahen hare ellu tehorin. vechen im hesit hammishkav et hakkelim o et hoochalim vehammashkin hare ellu tehorin: 
Hazzav vehattahor sheyyashvu bisfina ketanna hayechola lehamit baadam echad o beasda o sherachvu al gabbe behema af al pi sheen bigdehen nogin ze baze hare bigde hattahor temeim midras vetumatan besafek shemma daras hazzav alehen. vechen nidda sheyyashva im hattehora bammitta begadeha temein midras chutz mikkippa shebberoshah. vechen habbegadim shebberosh hannes shebbassefina tehorin: 
Hannidchak berechayim shehaakkum betocham o zav vechayyotze bo hare begadav temein midras. bee ze rechayim amru berechayim shemmenadnedin et hakkarka ad sheokrin et haomed kan vedochafin oto mimmekomo. vedavar barur hu shettuma zo besafek shemma neekar hattame vedaras al bigde hattahor:

Am haaretz af al pi shehu yisrael veyeshno betora uvemitzvot hare hu bechezkat tame uvegadav midras letohorot. veim nagu begadav boochalin umashkin hare hen temein. veim naga bichli cheres meaviro timmeahu. vesorfin et hatteruma al maggaan af al pi shettumatan besafek. veenan neemanin al hattohorot lefi sheenan bekiin bedikduke tohorot vetumot. uleolam hu bechezka zo veeno neeman al hattohorot ad sheyyekabbel alav divre chaverut. uma hen divre chaverut sheyyekabbel alav sheyyehe nizhar betumot shello yittamme bahen. uvetohorot shello yetamme otam. veyizzaher bintilat yadayim uvetohoratan shello yikkach meam haaretz davar lach velo yitareach etzlo velo yearcho etzlo bichsuto: 
Habba lekabbel divre chaverut chutz middavar echad mehen en mekabbelin oto. reinuhu shennoheg betzina betoch beto mekabbelin oto veachar kach melammedin oto iske tuma vetohora. veim lo reinuhu shennoheg betzina beveto melammedin oto veachar kach mekabbelin oto. umekabbelin oto techilla letohorat hayyadayim veachar kach mekabbelin oto letohorot. veim amar eni mekabbel ella letohorat hayyadayim mekabbelin oto. kibbel letohorot velo layyadayim af letohorot en mekabbelin oto. keshemmekabbelin oto choshshin lo kol sheloshim yom ad sheyyilmad veyihye ragil betohorot. veachar sheloshim yom mishsheyyekabbel divre chaverut hare begadav tehorin vechol ochalav umashkav tehorin veneeman al kol hattohorot kishar kol hachaverim veaf al pi sheeno talmid chacham: 
Talmide chachamim hare hen bechezkat tohora. neemanin veenan tzerichin lekabbel divre chaverut aval mishshecharav bet hammikdash nahagu kohanim silsul beatzman shello yehu mosrin tohorot afillu letalmide chachamim ad sheyyekabbel alav divre chaverut: 
Zaken veyoshev bishiva eno tzarich lekabbel shekkevar kibbel beshaa sheyyashav: 
Hamekabbel divre chaverut tzarich lekabbel bifne shelosha chaverim. uvanav uvene beto enan tzerichin lekabbel bifne shelosha mippene shehu melammedan umargilan bederech tohora. veeshet chaver uvanav uvene beto vaavadav hare hen kechaver. vechaver shemmet ishto uvanav uvene beto bechezkat chaverim ad sheyyechashdu: 
Eshet am haaretz o bitto shennisset lechaver vechen avdo shennimkar lechaver hare ellu tzerichin lekabbel alehen divre chaverut kevattechilla. aval eshet chaver o bitto shennisset leam haaretz vechen avdo shennimkar leam haaretz en tzerichin lekabbel divre chaverut kevattechilla: 
Am haaretz shekkibbel alav divre chaverut vehayu lo tohorot keshehaya am haaretz veamar ani yodea vadday shello nitmeu bizman shennitasseku bahen acherim hare hen asurot kemikkodem veim hu beatzmo nitassek bahen hare hen muttarot lo vaasurot lechol adam. venishal hechaver al tohorotav umore bahen tohora leatzmo veen choshdin oto bechach: 
Chaver shennaasa gabbay lammelech o mochsan vechayyotze bahen dochin oto mechaveruto. perash mimmaasav haraim hare hu kechol adam vetzarich lekabbel divre chaverut kevattechilla: 
Am haaretz shekkibbel alav divre chaverut venechshad ledavar echad eno chashud ella leoto davar. vechol hechashud lechamur nechshad al hakkal. lakkal lo nechshad lechamur: 
Chaver shennechshad al hattohorot kegon shemmachar ochalin temein bechezkat shehen tehorin hare ze eno neeman leolam ad sheyyivvada shechazar bitshuva gemura: 
Hechashud al hashsheviit o al hatteruma shemmecharan leshem chullin hare ze chashud al hattohorot shehechashud al davar shel tora hare hu chashud al divre sofrim. vehoochalin hattemein en metammein acherim ella middivrehen kemo sheyyitbaer. vechol hechashud al davar neeman lehaid bo laacherim veladun bo laacherim. chazaka hi sheen adam chote kede sheyyehanu bo acherim:

Kevar bearnu sheamme haaretz neemanim hen al tohorat parat hachattat mippene chumratah en mezalzelin bah. vechen neemanim hen al tohorat yayin veshemen shel nesachim im amar tahor hu hare ze bechezkat tohora mippene chumrato nizharin bo. vechen neemanim hen al hatteruma bishat haggittot vehabbaddim mippene shekkol haam metaharin atzman uchelehen kede laasot yenam veshamnam betohora. avru haggittot vehabbaddim enan neemanim: 
Kohen shehevi lo am haaretz chavit yayin o shemen shel teruma lo yekabbelenna mimmennu mippene shehi bechezkat tuma. hinnichah am haaretz etzlo ad gat habbaa veheviah lo yekabbelenna mimmennu af al pi shehu yodea shehi shel eshtakad shello gazru alehem tuma bishat haggittot vehabbaddim: 
Am haaretz shennaal bet baddo o gitto beshaa sheggamru haam lidroch veholich et hammafteach miyyad lechohen af al pi sheshshaha kamma yamim achar sheavru haggittot hare hakkohen ba ufoteach befanav umatbilo vedorech venotel teruma betohora. veim lo asa chen lo yittol teruma meam haaretz ella zetim vaanavim sheenan muchsharin sheenan mekabbelin tuma: 
Hevi lo am haaretz chavit shel teruma bishar yemot hashshana veamar hifrashti betochah kodesh afillu reviit mittoch shenneeman al tohorat hakkodesh neeman al hakkol afillu bishat haggittot vehabbaddim sheamme haaretz neemanin al hatteruma enan neemanin al hakkeli harekam lomar shehu tahor litruma. vechen en neemanin leolam al keli rekam lomar shehu tahor lekodesh: 
Keli shehaya betocho yayin o shemen verainu am haaretz yoshev umeshammero kede lehotzi mimmennu nesachim hare hu neeman al tohorat hakkeli vaafillu kodem laggittot velabbaddim beshivim yom. aval kodem leshivim enan neemanim. bamme devarim amurim bishar eretz yisrael. aval birushalayim neemanim al keli cheres harekam lomar shehu tahor lekodesh leolam ben kelim dakkim ben kelim gassim ben melein ben rekanim hare hu neeman al hakkeli af al pi shehammashkin shebbetocho temein. afillu haya bigdo shehu midras betoch hakkeli hare hakkeli bechezkat tohora lekodesh. umippene ma hekellu bahem mippene sheen osin kivshonot birushalayim: 
Min hammodiit ulefanim neemanim al keli cheres min hammodiit velachutz enan neemanin vehammodiit atzmah peamim kelachutz ufeamim kilfanim. ketzad. haya chaver nichnas veam haaretz yotze ucheli cheres beyado hare ze neeman bammodiit lomar shehu tahor lekodesh. hayu shenehen nichnasin o shenehen yotzin eno neeman ad sheyyehe lefanim min hammodiit: 
Kaddar shehevi kederot vehinnichan lefanim min hammodiit uvau hallokchin vehu omer lahen shettehorot hen. lakach kedera venichnas bah hare hi tehora lekodesh aval lo litruma kemo shebbearnu. lakach kedera veyatza bah chutz lammodiit hare zo temea ben lekodesh ben litruma af al pi shehen hen hakkederot. vehu hakkaddar atzmo eno neeman ella lefanim min hammodiit: 
Hallokeach kele cheres min hakkivshan bechol makom hare ellu tehorin ben lekodesh ben litruma veen omrim shemma naga bahen am haaretz. vaafillu lakach min hasseder harishon. veaf al pi shehakkivshan patuach uchevar nilkach chetzyo shello gazru tuma al kelim shebbakkivshan: 
Tumat am haaretz baregel kithora hi chashuva shekkol yisrael chaverim hen bargalim uchelehem kullam veochlehem umashkehen tehorim baregel mippene shehakkol metaharin atzman veolim laregel. lefichach hen neemanim kol yemot haregel ben al hakkodesh ben al hatteruma. mishsheavar haregel chozrin letumatan: 
Happoteach chavito baregel vehammatchil beissato veavar haregel hare shear hechavit ushear haissa bechezkat tuma shehare nagu bo amme haaretz. veaf al pi shello naga bah ella bizman shehu kechaver enah tehora ella bime haregel bilvad: 
Achar haregel bemotzae yom tov hayu matbilin kol hakkelim shehayu bammikdash mippene shennagu bahen amme haaretz baregel bishat hechag. ulefichach hayu omrim lahen al tiggeu bashshulchan beshaa shemmarin oto leole regalim kede shello yihye tame bemaggao achar haregel venimtza tzarich tevila vehaarev shemesh veneemar belechem happanim <small>(Shemot 25 30)</small> "lefanay tamid". vechol hakkelim hayu teunim tevila vehaarev shemesh chutz mimmizbach hazzahav umizbach hannechoshet mippene shetztzippuyehen kivtelin legabbehen: 
Am haaretz sheamar tahor ani mittumat met o sheamar keli ze tahor mittumat met neeman umatbilin oto mishshum tumat am haaretz bilvad vetzarich haarev shemesh veeno tzarich hazzaa. bamme devarim amurim besheshshaalu veamar tahor hu. aval hallokeach keli setam mershut am haaretz choshshin lo shemma teme met hu umazzin alav shelishi ushevii kechol hakkelim hannimtzaim bechol makom chutz lirushalayim shello gazru tuma al hakkelim hannimtzaim birushalayim kemo sheyyitbaer betumat hassefekot:

Hammafkid kelim etzel am haaretz o shennatan keli leumman am haaretz hare ellu temeim teme met utemein midras. veim makkiro shehu ochel bitruma tehorim mitteme met aval temeim midras mippene sheishto nidda yoshevet alehem shello middato shehare en nizharin min hattumot bevatte amme haaretz: 
Hammanniach kelav bifne am haaretz veamar lo shemor li et ellu hare ellu temein midras utehorin mitteme met. hinnichan al ketefo temein midras uteme met. shachach kelav bevet hakkeneset hare hen tehorin sheeno reshut am haaretz gemura. hinniach kelav bammerchatz uva umetzaan kemot shehen tehorin. umelammedin oto shello yaase chen. hinniach gitto uvoro af al pi shennichnas lair uva umatza am haaretz betziddo tehorin mippene sheen lo reshut sheyyikkanes: 
Hammoser mafteach beto leam haaretz kol shebbabbayit tahor shello masar lo ella shemirat hammafteach: 
Hammanniach kelav bechallonot shel merchatz venaal alehem af al pi shennatan hammafteach leam haaretz kelav tehorin. vechen im chatam al hachallon o asa lo siman afillu matza hachotam mekulkal hare kol ellu tehorin: 
Hammanniach am haaretz betoch beto leshamro veyashav hu merachok bizman shehu roe et hannichnasin veet hayyotzin hare kol shebbabbayit min hoochalin vehammashkin ucheli cheres sheeno mukkaf tzamid patil temein aval hammishkavot vehammerkavot ucheli cheres hammukkaf tzamid patil tehorin. veim eno roe lo et hannichnasin velo et hayyotzin kol shebbabbayit tame afillu haya kafut o kerut yadayim veraglayim hakkol tame mippene shehen birshut am haaretz: 
Chaver shehaya yashen beveto shel am haaretz vehayu kelim mekuppalim umunnachin tachat rosho vesandalo vechavito lefanav hare ellu tehorin mippene shehen bechezkat shemirat baalehen velo yigga bahen am haaretz shehare hu omer atta yeor veyabbit bi: 
Am haaretz sheshshaal mechaver mitta sheyyashen aleha veyashan aleha betoch beto shel chaver en tame ella otah hammitta vead makom shehu yachol lifshot et yado meotah hammitta veligga: 
Chaver sheamar leam haaretz shemor li para zo shello tikkanes labbayit o shello teshabber et hakkelim hare habbayit vehakkelim tehorim. shello masar lo ella shemirat happara. aval im amar lo shemor li bayit ze shello tikkanes bo happara vechelim ellu shello teshabberem hare hen temein: 
Hammanniach am haaretz betoch beto veyatza hinnicho er umetzao er yashen umetzao yashen o shehinnicho er umetzao yashen kol shebbabbayit tahor. hinnicho yashen umetzao er kol makom hakkarov mimmennu shehu yachol lifshot et yado veligga bo tame. vechen hammanniach ummanin betoch beto en tame ella ad makom sheyyecholin lifshot et yedehen veligga. veen omrim shemma alu al gabbe kisse o al sullam venagu bakkeli o boochalin hatteluyin lemala bakkotel: 
Eshet chaver shehinnicha eshet am haaretz tochenet betoch beta. afillu paska harechayim vaafillu hayu shetayim en tame ella makom sheyyecholin lifshot et yadan veligga. veen omrin shemma haachat tochenet vehashsheniyya balsha kol shebbabbayit veshemma nitlet vealta bammekomot haggevohot: 
Haishsha shennichnesa lehotzi pat leani yatzat umetzaattu omed betzad kikkarot afillu teruma hare hen tehorot sheen chezkato ligga shello birshut. vechen haishsha sheyyatza umatza eshet am haaretz chota gechalim mittachat hakkedera hare hakkedera tehora: 
Gabbae malchut shennichnesu letoch habbayit lemashken kol shebbabbayit tame. im yesh immahem akkum neemanim lomar lo naganu mippene sheemat haakkum alehen. bamme devarim amurim bizman sheyyesh sham edim shennichnesu o shehaya hammashkon beyadam. aval im amru hen meatzman nichnasnu aval lo naganu neemanin shehappe sheasar hu happe shehittir: 
Haggannavim shennichnesu letoch habbayit en tame ella mekom ragle haggannavim. mippene shehen mefachadin millivlosh ella (davar) shennotlin bimzumman. uma hen metammein bimkom halichatan hoochalin vehammashkin uchele cheres happetuchim aval hammishkavot vehammerkavot uchele cheres hammukkafin tzamid patil tehorin. veim yesh immahen akkum o ishsha hakkol tame: 
Haggabbaim vehaggannavim sheasu teshuva vehecheziru meatzman lo mechamat yira veamru lo naganu bechol ma shehaya babbayit keshennichnasnu hare ellu neemanim vaafillu al mekom raglehen: 
Hammanniach et beto patuach umetzao patuach o shemmetzao naul. afillu hinnicho naul umetzao patuach velo nignav mimmennu kelum kol shebbabbayit tahor. sheani omer haggannavim petachuhu venimlechu vehalchu lahem velo nichnesu: 
Kordom sheavad babbayit o shehinnicho bezavit zo uva umetzao bezavit acheret habbayit tame sheani omer adam tame nichnas lesham unetalo: 
Haddar im am haaretz bechatzer veshachach kelim bechatzer afillu chaviyyot mukkafot tzamid patil o tannur mukkaf tzamid patil hare ellu temein ad sheyyaase lattannur mechitztza gevoha asara tefachim kede shello yehe birshut am haaretz: 
Chaver shehayta lo mechitztza o sukka lifne pitcho shel am haaretz. o shehayta mechitztza o sukka shel am haaretz lifne pitcho shel chaver. kelim shebbetochah o kelim shebbammechitztza temeim. mippene sheyyesh leam haaretz besukka zo o bimchitztza zo reshut: 
Chaver shehaya gaggo lemala miggaggo shel am haaretz hare ze shoteach sham kelim umanniach tohorot vehen bechezkatan. af al pi sheam haaretz yachol lifshot yado veligga. vechen beakkum eno choshesh lo mishshum tuma velo mishshum yen nesech. hayu haggaggot ze betzad ze o shehaya gaggo shel am haaretz lemala veshatach hechaver kelim o hinniach tohorot begaggo. hare kol makom sheyyachol am haaretz lifshot et yado veligga bechezkat tuma: 
Shete chatzerot zo lefanim mizzo happenimit shel chaver vehachitzona shel am haaretz. chaver manniach sham kelim veshoteach sham perot af al pi sheyyad am haaretz maggaat lesham. mippene shennitpas alav kegannav: 
Chatzer hachaluka bimsifas vechaver betzad ze veam haaretz betzad ze tohorotav tehorot af al pi sheyyad am haaretz maggaat. mippene shehem birshut hechaver: 
Chaver shennafal dilyo letoch boro shel am haaretz vehalach lehavi bema yaalennu hare ze tame. mippene shehunnach birshut am haaretz shaa achat: 
Eshet am haaretz shennichnesa letoch beto shel chaver lehotzi beno o bitto o behemto shel chaver kol shebbabbayit tahor. mippene shennichnesa shello birshut. kaddar chaver shehichnis kederotav limkor veyarad lishtot hare happenimiyyot tehorot vehachitzonot temeot. bamme devarim amurim beshehinnichan samuch lirshut harabbim mippene shehaovrim vehashshavin nogim bachitzonot bishat halicha. aval hayu rechokot mershut harabbim im hayu kele ummanuto beyadav hakkol temeot mippene shekkelav mochichin shehunnechu limkor veyad hakkol memashmeshot bahen. en kele ummanuto beyado hakkol tehorot chezkatan shello naga bahen adam. chaver shehinniach ochalin umashkin al petach chanuto venichnas hare ellu temeim mippene shehaovrim vehashshavim memashmeshin bahen:

Kohen shettiher kelav legat zo vehinnichan laggat habbaa hare ellu bechezkatan. sheen amme haaretz nogin bechelim shel kohen ze shehen betoch gitto mippene shehu ochel tohorot. aval shel yisrael temeot ad sheyyomar belibbi haya lishmor am haaretz sheyyikkanes laggat shello yigga bechelim: 
Harotze laasot yeno betohora beummanin amme haaretz hare ze matbil et habbotzrim. vechen im haya ose shemen matbil et habbaddadin. vetzarich laamod al haummanim ad sheyyitbelu befanav shehare enan yodim hilchot tevila vachatzitza. yatzu chutz lefetach bet habbad venifnu achore haggader vechazru hare ellu betohoratan. ad kamma yarchiku vehem tehorin ad kede shello yissatru meenav. aval im nisteru meenav chazru letumatam ad sheyyatbilem paam acheret veyaariv shimshan: 
Habbaddadin vehabbotzrim shennimtzet tuma lifnehen neemanin lomar lo naganu. vechen betinokot shellahem: 
Hametaher et habbaddadin vehichnisan levet habbad venaal alehen. im hayu sham kelim shennitmeu bemidras hare bet habbad kullo tame shemma nagu beotan hakkelim. vaafillu raa otam mikkodem nizharin meotam hakkelim mippene tumatan hare bet habbad tame shemma hesitu vehen medammin sheen hammesit tame sheen amme haaretz bekiin betumat hesset: 
Hayu chammarav ufoalav toanin tohorot veovrin lefanav af al pi shehifligu yoter mimmil hare ellu tehorot mippene shehen bechezkat shehu shomran vehen mefachadin ligga veomrim achshav yavo shehare hu yavo acharenu. aval im amar lahem tzeu vaani avo acharechem kevan shennitkassu meenav hare hen temeot: 
Chaver shehaya lavush bechaluk veatuf betallit umehallech veamar belibbi haya lishmor et hechaluk vehayiti nizhar bo vehissachti dati min hattallit. hare hechaluk betohorato vehattallit temea shemma naga bah am haaretz. haya sal al ketefo umagrefa betoch hassal veamar belibbi haya lishmor et hassal velishmor et hammagrefa middavar hametammeah aval lo middavar happoslah hassal tahor vehammagrefa temea. vechol teruma shebbassal pesula mippene hammagrefa temea shepposelet hoochalin shebbassal. haya mishtammesh min hechavit betohora bechezkat shehi chullin veachar kach nimtzet teruma af al pi shehi tehora hare hi asura baachila shemma naga bah tevul yom shehu posel bitruma vetahor bechullin kemo sheyyitbaer. veeno dome meshammer teruma limshammer chullin. veim amar belibbi haya leshamro afillu middavar happoslah hare zo mutteret baachila. nitchallefu lo kelim shel shabbat bechelim shel chol ulevashan nitmeu. sheeno meshammer kelim shel chol kechelim shel shabbat. maase bishte nashim chaverot shennitchallefu lahen kelehen bevet hammerchatz uva maase lifne chachamim vetimmeu hakkol. afillu nafla maafartah mimmenna veamra lechaver tena li unetanah lah nitmet gezera shemma yittenenna lah am haaretz o shello yihye hechaver meshammerah sheen adam meshammer kelim sheenan shello kechelav ella im ken hodia shessamach alav: 
Chaver shemmet vehinniach tohorot hare ellu tehorot. hinniach kelim hare hen temeim sheani omer shemma nitmeu vehizza alehem bashshelishi velo hizza alehen bashshevii. o shemma hizza alehem bashshevii vaadayin lo hitbil. o shemma lo hizza alehen bashshevii kol ikkar: 
Mi sheamar lo ed echad nitmeu tohorotecha vehalla shotek hare ze neeman vahare hen temeot. veim hichchisho veamar lo nitmeu hare hen bechezkatan ad sheyyaidu shenayim. haya ose immo betohorot o bizvachim uleachar zeman metzao veamar lo beshaa sheppaga bo tohorot sheasiti immecha nitmeu uzevachim sheasiti immecha nitpaggelu hare ze neeman. aval im paga bo velo amar lo kelum veachar kach paga bo paam sheniyya veamar lo eno neeman ella hare zevachav bechezkat kashrut vetohorotav bechezkat tohora: berich rachamana desayyean
Mishneh Torah, Other Sources of Defileme: Hannevela av meavot hattumot. kezayit mibbesarah metamme adam vechelim bemagga uchele cheres baavir. umetamme et haadam bemassa letamme begadim kemerkav hazzav. ketzad. adam shennaga binvela nitma vahare hu rishon letuma. veim naga bechelim afillu bishat maggao binvela hare hen tehorin. vechen kelim shealav tehorin lefi [shehu] valad veen valad metamme kelim. aval hannose et hannevela metamme kelim bishat nesiato shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 11 28)</small> "vehannsho et nivlatam yechabbes begadav". veotan habbegadim rishon letuma. veeno metamme lo adam velo kele cheres vaafillu bishat nesiato kemo shebbearnu bimtammee mishkav umoshav:

Echad behema vechayya ben hammuttarin baachila ben haasurin im metu kullan besaran metamme bichzayit. ushechitat behema tehora vechayya tehora metaharto bechol makom. vaafillu shachat chullin baazara vekadashim bachutz hare ellu tehorin. veim era pissul bashshechita hare zo nevela umetammea bemassa kemo shebbearnu behilchot shechita:

Behema temea vechayya temea en hashshechita moelet bah veechad hashshochatah o hannocharah o hachonkah o shemmeta kedarkah hare zo nevela. vechol hannevelot mitztarfot leinyan tuma lichzayit echad temeot veechad tehorot:
Moach hare hu kevasar. vedam hannevela eno metamme kinvela ella hare hu kemashkin temeim sheeno metamme lo adam velo kelim min hattora:

Chelev behema tehora shemmeta tahor. shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 7 24)</small> "vechelev nevela vechelev terefa yease lechol melacha veachol lo tochluhu" mi sheissuro mishshum nevela uterefa. veim huchshar bemashkin hammachshirin hare hu koochalin temein veeno kivsar nevela. vehannogea bachelev hachofe et hakkulya kodem haferasha hare ze tame kenogea bakkulya atzmah shehare kamma chutin nimshachin mimmenna bachelev. aval behema temea vehachayya ben tehora ben temea echad besarah veechad chelbah letuma. umetamme adam vechelim bichzayit kivsar hannevela:
Hakkevi chelbo metamme kivsaro vetumato besafek. lefichach en sorfin alav teruma vekadashim veen chayyavin karet al tumato veal biat hammikdash o al achilat kadashav:

Veellu devarim sheen metammein min hannevelot. haatzamot vehakkarnayim vehattelafayim afillu ikkaran harach sheim yachtoch min hachay yotze dam. vehaor af al pi sheeno meubbad. vehaalal vehaggidim vehammarak vehattavlin shemmitbashshelin immah. bamme devarim amurim bizman sheppershu min hannevela. aval hannogea beechad mikkol ellu keshehen mechubbarin babbasar hare ze tame. vehu sheyyihye babbasar kezayit. sheen echad mikkol ellu mitztaref lichzayit:
Haalal ben sheppelatattu chayya ben sheppelatattu sakkin eno mitztaref lichzayit. veim kenaso vehaya bo kezayit metamme:

Veellu behemot sheorotehem kivsaram. or chazir shel yishshuv veor chatoteret haggamal harakka veor bet habboshet veor hashshelil veor shettachat haalya. hare ellu metammein min hannevela. veim ibbedan o halach bahen kede avoda hare ellu tehorim. veim asa bahen maase shebbittelan tehorin af al pi shello halach bahen kede avoda. ketzad. ozen chamor shettelaah lichfifato tehora. kamma hu kede avoda arbaa milin. vee zo hi chatoteret rakka kol zeman shello taana. higgia zemannah liton velo taana o shettaana kodem sheyyaggia zemannah hare ze safek:

Hammafshit nivlat behema o chayya ben temea ben tehora ben dakka ben gassa. im lishticha hifshit kevan shehifshit min haor kede achiza vehu shene tefachim hannogea beor ze shehufshat tahor. vead shello hifshit shene tefachim hannogea baor kenogea babbasar. hifshitah kede laasot min haor chemet hare haor chibbur ad sheyyafshit et kol hechaze. veim hifshitah meragleha bilvad hare haor kullo chibbur vehannogea baor kenogea babbasar ad sheyyafrish haor kullo meal habbasar. vechen hammafshit bishratzim chibbur ad sheyyafshit kullo. or sheal hatztzavvar chibbur ad sheyyafshit kullo. vechol or shehu chibbur letamme kach hu chibbur lehittamme. sheim hayta shechuta venaga tuma beor ze shehu chibbur nitma habbasar:

Or sheyyesh alav kezayit nevela hannogea batztziv hayyotze mimmennu uvisaro shekkenegdo meachore haor nitma mippene shehaor bisaro shomer labbasar. bamme devarim amurim sheppelatattu chayya. aval pelatattu sakkin im haya meruddad batel aggav haor:

Or sheyyesh alav kishne chatzae zetim besar nevela haor mevattelan veenan metammein lo bemagga velo bemassa. shekkol sheeno metamme min hannevela bemagga eno metamme bemassa. aval shene chatzae zetim shettechavan bekesam hannosan tame shehare nasa kezayit vehannogea tahor sheen chibbure adam chibbur vehu sheyyihyu shenehen meruddadin udevukin ze baze ad sheyyinnatlu keechad. aval im haya chatzi zayit ze bifne atzmo veze bifne atzmo bekesam echad afillu holich vehevi kol hayyom kullo tahor:

Besar nevela shennifsad vehivish venifsal milleechol hakkelev tahor. lefichach netzel hannevela safek im metamme bichzayit im lo. besar nevela sheyyavash im yachol lishrot befoshrin meet leet velachazor lach verauy lakkelev metamme veim lav tahor vaafillu koochalin temein eno mittame:

Besar nevela shehaya saruach meikkaro veeno rauy lemaachal adam hare ze tahor shenneemar <small>(Devarim 14 21)</small> "lagger asher bisharecha tittenenna vaachalah" ad shettihye techillatah reuya leger:
Shilya shel nevela hare hi keferesh ucherei veenah metammea kinvela. veim chashav aleha laachila mittamme tumat ochalin. hakkeva vehechalav shel nevela tehorin mikkelum:

Behema sheshshafa chararat dam af al pi shenniftera min habbechora enah metammea lo bemagga velo bemassa ad sheyyihye bah tzurat nefel lefi shehi betela barov hayyotze immah. lefichach hi tehora af al pi shehayta reuya lagger aggav immah:

Nevela shennitarva bishchuta im rov min hashshechuta betela hannevela bashshechuta veen hakkol metamme bemagga. aval im nasa hakkol nitma shei efshar lishchuta shettachzor nevela aval hannevela efshar shettithar keshettisrach lefichach tibbatel:
